up: Retrieve the ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for all unique compounds that have been tested in assays against human carbonic anhydrase II. The assays must be performed on human organisms.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE
  td.pref_name = 'Carbonic anhydrase II'
  AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
  AND ass.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens';

sql:
